message:
As parents, we often find ourselves in that delightful tug-of-war with our kids over what’s necessary and what’s not. When it comes to being prepared for travel, it can be easy to overlook a few essential items that make a big difference. This resource from Ready.gov offers some helpful tips on what to keep in your car, ensuring we’re ready for those unexpected moments on the road. 

Let’s make this a family conversation and see what our little adventurers think we should pack. After all, they might surprise us with their creativity! 🚗
